author: reek
body: This reads the dword RAW, without `pci-config-read-raw`'s mask, because the mask is what a guest does to defend itself and the question here is what the machine handed it in the first place. Masked, the answer is the same on a correct machine and a broken one, which is the definition of an arm that cannot fail.

author: reek
body: The `bed not armed` branch below is therefore unreachable on any machine with an empty slot. It is kept because a bus with no bit-31 dword at all would make every other row vacuous, and a probe that cannot say "I was never armed" reports the same thing whether it passed or never ran.

author: reek
body: Walks device slots on bus 0 and answers the raw reading for the first dword whose low half is a vendor id and whose high half sets bit 31.

author: reek
body: Answers the first raw dword with bit 31 set, or zero if the bus carries none. Self-recursive so the loop is a tail call.
